AND CONT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

SELECT A.CONT_ID AS contId , A.SALES_ID AS salesId , A.CONT_NM AS contNm , A.CONT_AMT AS contAmt , A.START_DT AS startDt , A.END_DT AS endDt , A.CONT_DT AS contDt , A.PIC_USER_ID AS picUserId , A.CONT_STATUS AS contStatus , A.CONT_REMARK AS contRemark , B.SALES_TITLE AS salesTitle , B.SALES_USER_ID AS salesUserId , C.USER_NM AS picUserNm , D.USER_NM AS salesUserNm , E.CUST_NM AS custNm FROM TB_CONTRACT A LEFT JOIN TB_SALES B ON A.SALES_ID = B.SALES_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER C ON A.PIC_USER_ID = C.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER D ON B.SALES_USER_ID = D.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CUSTOMER E ON B.CUST_ID = E.CUST_ID WHERE CONT_ID = #{contId} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
